title:
A little studio.
A lot of heart.
description: Independent graphic design by Sejal. For brands, celebrations and ideas that deserve their own visual voice.
paragraphs: I’m Sejal, the founder of Desira. I create custom logos, posters, invitations and event graphics, helping ideas find a visual language of their own.
Desira brings a personal approach to design: a conversation about your story, a considered direction, and care for the details that make the final piece feel like you.
